verdict.rationale: Langfuse has dedicated LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation docs describing using an LLM to assess outputs with numeric/categorical/boolean scores, applicable both to offline experiments/datasets and automatically to live production traces, plus reference-free hallucination/faithfulness examples showing configurable judge evaluators in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of the judge configuration UI/workflow (community evidence covers tracing/prompt management but not LLM-as-judge specifically).
